about.title: The Person Behind the Lens
about.p1: Welcome to JBergentdecker — a personal space dedicated to the mountains and everything they offer. Whether it's a summer hiking trail, a technical alpine route, or a winter ski tour, each outing is a story worth telling.
about.p2: Here you'll find a photography portfolio from my adventures across the Alps and beyond, alongside detailed tour reports with maps, stats and honest notes for fellow mountain enthusiasts.
